inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required: Staff file reviewed lacked 15 hour training certificates for the required 30 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training -30 Hours Required (26 TAC §747.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One out of the four children's files reviewed lacked the health statement..
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The privacy fence had various loose boards creating gaps that children can put their hands through.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: An infant not yet on table food did not have infant feeding instructions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance: The operation did not update their liability insurance information by the renewal date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Liability Insurance Requirements -  Provide Proof of Coverage Annually by Anniversary Date of Issuance (26 TAC §747.209(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A child under 2 years old was observed watching a movie on the television. This was corrected when it was addressed with the caregiver and she turned off the tv and moved the child from in front of the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §747.2105(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child did not have a copy of their immunization record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Five children did not have a health statement on file signed by a doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: None of the children's files reviewed had signed proof that parents recieved Parent Rights form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File: Three children enrolled did not have signed health statements on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Health Statement on File (26 TAC §747.611(b))

occurrences.finding: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation: A household member did not have a signed statement of orientation on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personnel Records for Household Members - Orientation (26 TAC §747.905(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Record Upon Admission: A child in care did not have immunization records on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Record Upon Admission (26 TAC §747.613(c))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two children did not have signed Authorization for Emergency Medical attention on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child is missing signed authorization for emergency care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization (26 TAC §747.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke and carbon monoxide detector were not tested in the previous three months. The fire extinguisher was not inspected in the previous three months as well.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Bug sprays along with cleaning solutions were observed in the backyard accessible to the children in care. Note: This was corrected at inspection as the liquids were removed out of children's reach.     A storage box was observed containing tools with no lock therefore making them accessible to the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The cots were observed not labeled with the children's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §747.4303(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The required monthly fire drills were not conducted and documented for the previous three months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Three out of four children's records reviewed did not include immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not observed mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Three out of the four children's record reviewed during inspection did not contain the address for the emergency contact.     Three out of the four children's records did not contain the date of admission.     Three out of the four children's records did include the name, address, and telephone number of the child s physician or an emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The operation did not have the following required postings posted: recent inspection form, employee list and emergency numbers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))
